categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Has Mining label, modifies node block template management (`BlockTemplateManager`), and updates `getblocktemplate` caching behavior.
categories.rationale: Removes process-scoped static cache variables in `getblocktemplate` in favor of managing cache lifetime in `BlockTemplateManager`. This addresses tracking issue #33758, fixes test-only lifetime issues where `CBlockIndex*` outlived `ChainstateManager`, adds compile-time thread safety annotations, and adds unit test coverage for template invalidation.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: The changes in `src/rpc/mining.cpp` merely delegate template caching to internal mining subsystems without altering RPC interfaces, schemas, or transport behavior.
categories.rationale: Not an RPC category change; the RPC layer is only touched mechanically to move domain-specific mining template caching into `BlockTemplateManager`.
